name: ponytail-audit
title_zh: 整仓扫一遍，告诉你哪行代码可以直接删
tagline_zh: 改完 diff 干净不代表仓库干净。它把整个代码库过一遍，按「删掉最省事」排序，指出哪些能删。
tagline_en: A clean diff doesn't mean a clean repo. It scans the whole codebase and ranks what to delete, simplify, or swap.
desc_en: Whole-repo audit for over-engineering. Like ponytail-review, but scans the entire codebase instead of a diff: a ranked list of what to delete, simplify, or replace with stdlib/native equivalents. Use when the user says "audit this codebase", "audit for over-engineering", "what can I delete from this repo", "find bloat", "ponytail-audit", or "/ponytail-audit". One-shot report, does not apply fixes.
why_zh: 按可删收益排序而不是按文件顺序，先砍大头。判断依据是标准库和语言原生能力，不是风格偏好。
why_en: Ranks by deletion payoff, not file order, so the big cuts come first. Judgments rest on stdlib and native language features, not.
limit_zh: 只出报告，一行代码都不改，想让它顺手修得自己动手。全仓扫描对大仓库慢且吃上下文，超大 monorepo 可能扫不全。
limit_en: Report only, edits nothing. Slow and context-hungry on large repos; huge monorepos may not be fully covered. Its stdlib-equivalence calls can miss.
title_en: Whole-repo scan: what you can delete outright
